answer: Each epoch offers one relay slot, and identities bid for it sealed. The highest bid wins but pays only the runner-up's price, so a farm of cloned keys bids against its own clones and hands its surplus back to itself. Every bid carries a fresh memory-hard proof over the key, epoch seed and nonce, with difficulty rising as bids accumulate, so each extra clone buys quadratic cost for linear gain and no proof is shared across keys. Where the tundra of clones meets the vine of one honest bidder, the violet price is the only honest clearing.
